an3.80:1.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.80:1.2: sammukhāmetaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ :
an3.80:1.3: “bhagavato ānanda, sikhissa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesī”ti.
an3.80:1.4: bhagavā pana bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetunti.
an3.80:2.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.80:3.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.80:3.2: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ :
an3.80:3.3: “bhagavato ānanda, sikhissa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpesī”ti.
an3.80:3.4: bhagavā pana bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kīvatakaṃ pahoti sarena viññāpetunti.
an3.80:3.5: sutā te ānanda, sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātūti :
an3.80:3.6: etassa bhagavā kālo. etassa sugata, kālo.
an3.80:3.7: yaṃ bhagavā bhāseyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an3.80:4.1: yāvatā ānanda, candimasuriyā pariharanti, disā bhanti virocanā, tāva sahassadhā loko.
an3.80:4.2: tasmiṃ sahassadhā loke sahassaṃ candānaṃ, sahassaṃ suriyānaṃ, sahassaṃ sinerupabbatarājānaṃ, sahassaṃ jambudīpānaṃ, sahassaṃ aparagoyānānaṃ, sahassaṃ uttarakurūnaṃ, sahassaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, cattāri mahāsamuddasahassāni, cattāri mahārājasahassāni, sahassaṃ cātummahārājikānaṃ, sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ, sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ, sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ, sahassaṃ nimmāṇaratīnaṃ, sahassaṃ paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ, sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ.
an3.80:5.1: yāvatānanda sahassī cūḷanikā lokadhātu, tāva sahassadhā loko.
an3.80:6.1: yāvatā ānanda, dvisahassī majjhimikā lokadhātu, tāva sahassadhā loko.
an3.80:7.1: ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, tathāgato tisahassīmahāsahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya, yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyāti?
an3.80:8.1: yathā kathampana bhante, bhagavā tisahassīmahāsahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya, yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyāti.
an3.80:8.3: yadā te sattā taṃ ālokaṃ sañjāneyyuṃ, atha tathāgato ghosaṃ kareyya saddamanussāveyya.
an3.80:8.4: evaṃ kho ānanda, tathāgato tisahassīmahāsahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyya, yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyyāti.
an3.80:9.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.80:9.2: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,
an3.80:9.3: yassa me satthā evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvoti.
an3.80:9.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca :
an3.80:9.5: kiṃ tumhettha, āvuso ānanda, yadi te satthā evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvoti?
an3.80:9.6: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca :
an3.80:9.7: mā hevaṃ udāyi, mā hevaṃ udāyi.
an3.80:9.8: sace udāyi, ānando avītarāgo kālaṃ kareyya, tena cittappasādena sattakkhattuṃ devesu devarajjaṃ kareyya, sattakkhattuṃ imasmiññeva jambudīpe mahārajjaṃ kareyya.
an3.80:9.9: api udāyi, ānando diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyissatīti.
